description: This source file contains the implementation of the `ConnectionLoggerRegistry` class, which manages connection-specific loggers for a messaging connectivity service, including initialization, log aggregation, muting/unmuting, and log capacity management.

classes.name: ConnectionLoggerRegistry
classes.description: Manages loggers for connectivity connections, supporting log aggregation, muting, unmuting, and configuration-based initialization. Maintains per-connection log capacity and size constraints, and handles connection-specific logging metadata.

classes.name: ConnectionLoggerRegistry.ConnectionLogs
classes.description: Immutable object representing logs collected for a connection, including enablement timestamps.

classes.name: ConnectionLoggerRegistry.MapKey
classes.description: Immutable key class for registry map entries, differentiating loggers by connection ID, category, type, and address.

classes.name: ConnectionLoggerRegistry.LogMetadata
classes.description: Immutable class storing timing metadata about when logging was enabled and until when.

methods.name: aggregateLogs
methods.description: Collects and sorts log entries for a specified connection, respecting size and length limits, returning a ConnectionLogs object.

methods.name: restrictMaxLogEntriesLength
methods.description: Limits the number of log entries based on maximum byte size by removing oldest entries.

methods.name: isActiveForConnection
methods.description: Determines if logging is active (not muted) for a connection.

methods.name: isLoggingExpired
methods.description: Checks whether logging for a connection has expired based on timestamps.

methods.name: muteForConnection
methods.description: Mutes all loggers for a specific connection, preventing further logging.

methods.name: unmuteForConnection
methods.description: Reactivates logging for a specific connection.

methods.name: streamLoggers
methods.description: Streams all loggers associated with a specific connection.

methods.name: initForConnection
methods.description: Initializes loggers for a connection by creating log categories based on connection addresses and target, as well as response and general connection logs.

methods.name: initLogger
methods.description: Creates and registers a new logger for a specific connection, category, type, and optional address.

methods.name: resetForConnection
methods.description: Resets loggers associated with a connection, clearing their logs.

methods.name: refreshMetadata
methods.description: Updates or creates logging timing metadata for a connection.

methods.name: startMetadata
methods.description: Begins logging timing metadata for a connection.

methods.name: stopMetadata
methods.description: Removes logging timing metadata for a connection.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves logging timing metadata for a connection.

methods.name: forOutboundDispatched
methods.description: Provides a logger for outbound dispatched messages to a specific target.

methods.name: forOutboundFiltered
methods.description: Provides a logger for outbound filtered messages to a specific target.

methods.name: forOutboundPublished
methods.description: Provides a logger for outbound published messages to a specific target.

methods.name: forOutboundDropped
methods.description: Provides a logger when outbound messages are dropped for a specific target.

methods.name: forOutboundAcknowledged
methods.description: Provides a logger for acknowledgement of outbound messages to a specific target.

methods.name: forInboundConsumed
methods.description: Provides a logger for inbound consumed messages from a specific source.

methods.name: forInboundMapped
methods.description: Provides a logger for inbound mapped messages from a specific source.

methods.name: forInboundEnforced
methods.description: Provides a logger for inbound enforced messages from a specific source.

methods.name: forInboundDropped
methods.description: Provides a logger for inbound dropped messages from a specific source.

methods.name: forInboundAcknowledged
methods.description: Provides a logger for inbound acknowledged messages from a specific source.

methods.name: forResponseDispatched
methods.description: Provides a logger for dispatched responses.

methods.name: forResponseDropped
methods.description: Provides a logger for dropped responses.

methods.name: forResponseMapped
methods.description: Provides a logger for mapped responses.

methods.name: forResponsePublished
methods.description: Provides a logger for published responses.

methods.name: forResponseAcknowledged
methods.description: Provides a logger for acknowledged responses.

methods.name: forConnection
methods.description: Provides a logger associated with the connection itself, not specific to message direction or type.

methods.name: getLogger
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a logger node with specific connection, category, type, and optional address.
